purpose: Research hindcasts and controlled candidate comparison; no strategy optimization or live authority
primary_score: standardized marginal ensemble CRPS, averaged over variables and months
new_selection_windows: Only evaluation intervals explicitly disjoint from previously consumed batches; chronological eras overlap elsewhere only for diagnostic reporting
reconstruction: Existing 2020-2025 ETF gate is already inspected and remains frozen diagnostic; never called untouched
macro_availability: Release/vintage rows must be <= forecast origin. Current revised history may be used only with an explicit pseudo-real-time research label and promotion block
daily_bridge: Monthly predictions do not identify daily observations. Any future daily bridge is a separately seeded hypothetical conditional path model
